name: Capital Infra Trust
summary: Capital Infra Trust, an infrastructure investment trust, engages in building, operating, and management of road construction projects and all other related activities in India. The company focuses on investing in infrastructure projects primarily national highways. The company was formerly known as National Infrastructure Trust and changed its name to Capital Infra Trust in October 2024. Capital Infra Trust was incorporated in 2023 and is based in Gurugram, India.
